name: Finch
one_liner: Self-care habit app: you look after a virtual pet bird by checking in on your mood, setting small goals and doing short exercises.
best_for: People who want a low-pressure, playful way to build small daily self-care habits
People who like gentle reminders and mood check-ins without clinical language
not_for: Anyone in crisis or thinking about suicide: call or text 988
People looking for therapy or a structured treatment program for depression or anxiety
People who find streaks, rewards or game mechanics stressful
short_description: Virtual-pet self-care app with mood check-ins, small daily goals, breathing and journaling. Free core features; optional Finch Plus.
long_description: Finch, from Finch Care Public Benefit Corporation, turns daily self-care into looking after a virtual pet. Each day you check in on how you feel, pick small goals, and can do short breathing exercises, journaling prompts, reflections and sleep routines; completing them earns energy for your bird's adventures. The app tracks mood over time and lets you connect with friends' pets. Finch says all core self-care features are and will stay free; Finch Plus adds customization, more content options and faster seasonal rewards. It is a habit and self-care tool, not treatment, and we found no published study of it.
patient_summary: You adopt a small bird and help it grow by doing your own self-care: a morning and evening check-in, tiny goals like drinking water or going outside, and short breathing, journaling or reflection exercises. It is gentle and playful, which some people find easier on low-energy days. The core app is free; Finch Plus is an optional subscription for extras.

pricing.notes: Finch says all core self-care features are free. Finch Plus (customization, extra content and rewards) is billed through Apple or Google; prices may vary by region and platform.

privacy.notes: We could not read the app's privacy policy (linked from the store listing); Finch's separate merch-shop policy allows ad use, so grade left unknown.

seo.title: Finch: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Finch is a self-care app where you look after a virtual pet by checking in, setting small goals and doing short wellbeing exercises.

faqs.a: Free; Finch Plus from about $9.99/month. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Finch before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Finch replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Finch is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
Finch is available on iPhone and Android.
Daily check-ins and goals; Mood tracking and insights; Breathing exercises; Journaling prompts; Sleep routines.
